### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | 無 JCLP 專屬 AI 政策頁面(投稿指南頁全文檢索 'generative'/'artificial intelligence' 均未命中期刊專屬條款,僅頁尾版權聲明提及 TDM/AI 訓練保留權利)。適用的是 Wiley 集團通用政策(Best Practice Guidelines on Research Integrity and Publishing Ethics,AIGC 章節):允許作者使用生成式 AI 輔助寫作,但(1)不得列為作者,(2)投稿時必須揭露使用情形(用途、是否影響論點、如何人工核實),(3)作者對內容正確性全責。屬於「有條件允許」而非全開放或禁止,故 leniency 標 3。因非期刊專屬確認頁,signal_quality 僅 2。 |
| **Source URL** | https://authors.wiley.com/ethics-guidelines/index.html |

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Original empirical papers, conceptual analyses, comprehensive/systematic reviews & meta-analyses, training-and-professional-issues articles, and invitation-only 'In Session' case reports — scope centers on psychotherapy process/effectiveness, psychodiagnostics/assessment, treatment matching, clinical outcomes, clinical health psychology and behavioral medicine (per official Wiley aims-and-scope on the author guidelines page). No live 2025-2026 special-issue CFP was located in this search pass.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** empirical/quantitative clinical outcome studies, systematic reviews and meta-analyses, conceptual/theoretical analyses, training & professional-education research, invited clinical case reports (In Session)

- **ai_policy.leniency (journal-specific)**: JCLP 投稿指南頁全文未出現 'generative' 或期刊專屬 AI 政策段落;僅適用 Wiley 集團通用 AIGC 政策,非期刊獨有確認,故信心較低。
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: SciRev 該刊頁面此欄位標示 n/a;LetPub、科研通(ablesci)頁面均為行銷/框架頁,無社群實際填報數據;未找到小木虫該刊專屬討論串;Reddit r/AskAcademia 對此刊搜尋 0 結果。
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: 唯一可用的第一手來源(SciRev 1 則評論)僅描述單一負面流程事件(審稿人中途更換、意見不一致),樣本過小且未涉及審稿人整體文化/風格,不足以支撐一般化描述,故留空避免以偏概全。
- **positioning.accepts_now (current CFP)**: 本次搜尋未能定位到 JCLP 現行(2025-2026)的 special issue call for papers 頁面,僅有常態 aims & scope 描述,故該子項留空。
